visual.general_description: Schematic drawing of the pressure and breathing-gas profile of a single 90 min hyperbaric oxygen session.
visual.detailed_description: Colored time-pressure schematic with Compression and Decompression labels, a green 72% Oxygen versus light blue Air legend, printed pressure labels and a minutes axis.

panels.general_description: Colored schematic of a hyperbaric session: rising pressure, a long plateau and a falling pressure, with green and light blue breathing-gas bands.
panels.detailed_description: White background figure with the words Compression on the upper left and Decompression on the upper right. A legend at the top shows a light blue swatch labelled Air and a green swatch labelled 72% Oxygen. A trapezoid-shaped filled shape rises from the lower left, forms a flat top and falls to the lower right; its top edge is drawn with a black arrow along the plateau and short black arrow-like slopes on both sides. Printed numbers 2.5 stand above both ends of the flat top, 1.6 stands beside the rising edge and 1.2 beside the falling edge. Rotated labels read 1.0 m/min on the left and 1.5 m/min on the right, each next to a rotated bold ATA label. The shape is mostly green; light blue appears as a wedge at the start of the rising edge, as two narrow vertical bands crossing the green region in its middle part, and as a small wedge at the end of the falling edge. A white double dotted horizontal line runs across the lower part of the shape. The horizontal axis is labelled Time (minutes) and prints the tick labels 0, 6, 15, 31, 34, 59, 62, 80, 87 and 90, with thin dashed vertical lines at two plateau ends.

visual.general_description: Axial FLAIR brain MR slices of four patients before HBOT with numbered lesion arrowheads.
visual.detailed_description: Black-background composite of twelve axial grayscale brain slices in four rows labelled Pt 1, Pt 2, Pt 3 and Pt 4 in yellow on the left, and three columns headed A, B and C in yellow. Numbered red arrowheads mark lesions: Pt 1 has arrowheads 1 to 3 in column A, 4 to 7 in column B and 8 to 10 in column C; Pt 2 has 1 in column A, 2 to 5 in column B and 6 to 9 in column C; Pt 3 has 1 to 3 in column A, 4 to 7 in column B and 8 to 11 in column C; Pt 4 has 1 to 3 in column A, 4 and 5 in column B and 6 and 7 in column C. In Pt 1 a bright, mottled, heterogeneous region lies on the image right side beside a dilated ventricle in all three slices. In Pt 2 several small bright rounded foci with dark centres are scattered in the deep white matter in column C, bright periventricular signal and a dark basal ganglia region appear in column B, and column A is a lower slice through the brainstem and cerebellum. In Pt 3 a large dark, fluid-intensity region occupies the image-left side of the slices with an enlarged adjacent ventricle and surrounding bright rim, and a second smaller dark round region appears in column C. In Pt 4 a bright mottled region with dark spaces lies beside the image-right ventricle in all three slices with ventricular enlargement. The skull and scalp outline is visible around each slice. No names, dates, scanner overlays or other text appear other than the yellow row and column labels and the red arrowhead numbers.
